concepts.gloss_en: The illuminating word/speech — speech that shines by virtue of guarding God's honor (Torah 11); singular and plural forms of one concept

members.note: plural of the same concept, same Torah (lm1:11), same 'illuminating speech' motif tied to guarding kavod Hashem

notes: Only difference is grammatical number (singular vs plural); both in lm1:11 refer to the same 'illuminating speech' attained through kavod. Merged as 'likely' rather than 'obvious' since number is not a purely orthographic variant.
